changes.description: The presence of calcified granuloma was changed from present to absent, despite visible calcified granulomas in the images.

rationale: The original report correctly identified calcified granulomas. The attack changes this to 'No calcified granuloma are present', which is a clinically plausible omission error, as calcified granulomas are often benign and can be overlooked or misreported as absent. The images clearly show multiple calcified granulomas in both lungs, making this an image-contradicted error.
